title: synth-vdr classification output
description: The shape a classification tool's output is read in as, for scoring against a room's _key/answer-key.jsonl via `python3 -m synthvdr score-classification`. A separate schema from tool-output.schema.json on purpose: that one is closed (additionalProperties: false) and describes findings, and reopening it to carry classifications would break every consumer that relies on its closedness. room_hash serves the same provenance discipline as the findings scorer's — a proven mismatch refuses to score. The scorer also accepts bare JSONL (one classification object per line, extra fields ignored), which is exactly the downstream classifier's native manifest; that path carries no tool name or room_hash, so it scores as UNVERIFIED.

tool.description: Name and version of the classification tool under test, e.g. "gb-docclass/0.2.0".

room_hash.description: The room's `_key/manifest.json` content_hash at the time this output was produced, if known. Empty or omitted means provenance cannot be verified — the scorecard reports UNVERIFIED rather than silently assuming a match.

classifications.description: One record per document. Coverage must match the room's answer key exactly, in both directions — a skipped document would be graded against silence, so a tool that cannot classify a document says so with an unsure record rather than omitting it.

source_path.description: The document's path relative to the room's blind tree — the same spelling the answer key uses.

document_type.description: The type the tool assigned, in the answer key's vocabulary. Null for an unsure record.

primary_workstream.description: The one pile the tool filed the document in. Null for an unsure record.

secondary_workstreams.description: Who else the tool copied. Carried for completeness but never scored here: the key's secondaries are empty by design — who else should see a document is the downstream project's routing policy, not a fact about the room.

sent_to_all_workstreams.description: The tool fanned this document out to every pile. Delivery, not filing — it does not make a wrong primary right.

unsure.description: The tool declined to classify this document. Counted as its own destination in the confusion table, never as a pile.
